## Linear issue

Link the Linear issue for this change (example: `CS-7`).

## Summary

What changed and why?

## Validation

- [ ] The issue acceptance criteria are satisfied or remaining gaps are documented.
- [ ] The change was tested locally or the reason it was not tested is documented.
- [ ] No unrelated work is bundled into this PR.
- [ ] Documentation/README changes are included when behavior or setup changed.

## Review

- [ ] The PR was manually reviewed by the Product Owner/team lead or another appropriate teammate, unless explicitly exempted as trivial.
- [ ] Review comments that block merge are resolved.

## Merge

Default to **squash merge** so `main` stays readable and each Linear issue normally maps to one merge commit.
